meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量读取和加工生物序列数据,自动跑比对与进化分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常处理 FASTA、GenBank、PDB 等生物数据并需要批量化流程
copy.tagline_en: Batch-process biological sequence data and automate alignment and phylogenetic analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly handle FASTA, GenBank, or PDB data in batch pipelines

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能处理 DNA/RNA/蛋白质序列:读写 FASTA、GenBank、PDB 等文件,做比对、BLAST 检索和进化树分析,并通过 Bio.Entrez 查询 NCBI、PubMed。产出通常是可运行的 Python 脚本。
howto.when: 当你要处理序列和文件格式、查询 NCBI/PubMed、跑 BLAST 与比对分析时触发。需要 Python 3.10+、NumPy 和 Biopython;联网示例(Entrez、web BLAST)还需网络。

howto.what_en: Claude reads and writes FASTA, GenBank and PDB files, runs BLAST, alignments and phylogenetic trees, and queries NCBI/PubMed via Bio.Entrez. Output is usually runnable Python code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with sequences and file formats, query NCBI/PubMed, or run BLAST and alignment analysis. Requires Python 3.10+, NumPy and Biopython; networked examples also need internet.
